CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

7. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

8. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

11. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Green, orange, and purple

12. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

13. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)

14. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. Only the costume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. The ticket price

15. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)

----
